notes.title: Cyberpong Pricing
notes.content:
Greetings!

Today we lowered the price of Cyberpong to $8.99. Why did we do this? Great question!

When we originally priced Cyberpong at $14.99 we did so for several reasons. For one, VR is brand new and because of this we as developers are still exploring and testing many different areas. Since there isn't really an industry standard to refer to quite yet, we looked at the dev time that went into making the game and the quality of the product as a whole to determine a fair and competitive price. Now that the VR market has had some time to grow we've compared the features and price points of similar titles and have decided to lower the price accordingly.

TL;DR:
New market = lots of exploration & testing. If you haven't gotten the game you totes should now.

Thank you everyone for your support thus far, we look forward to what the future of VR holds.

notes.title: Proxy’s Log - Entry 39
notes.content:
...Bit and I were called in to clear out an old sector with an “extensive amount of data built up”. I went ahead and scoped out the area and let’s just say “extensive” is understatement...Why is there so much temp data in such an old sector and why do we have to clean it up?? No one uses this area anymore...oh well, a job’s a job, right? 

I uploaded the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=759824988&searchtext=]sector coords[/url] to the Cyberpong database, hopefully some other Cleaners will see it and send help. If not, we’re in for a long day.

Proxy out.

notes.title: Update #6!
notes.content:
Hey Cyberpongers!

The next update is out and we’re introducing a new feature! The Cyberpong Level Editor! Create waves of your own design and rise to popularity with fun, challenging and interesting waves. Then share your wondrous creations on the Steam workshop for your fellow Cyberpongers to enjoy. 

To access the level editor, right click " Cyberpong VR " in the steam library window and click 'Launch Game Editor'

We've also added a Multiplayer match notifier to our Single Player mode, that allows you to pause your single player game and join someone waiting in the multiplayer lobby. 

For anyone playing on LAN with friends there is now a quick rematch button to keep the games going! 

Detailed instructions will be coming soon on how to create a level!
